entries.headline: Elevated U.S. military aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six large U.S. military transport aircraft airborne over the continental United States alongside surveillance aircraft and a nuclear-command aircraft, describing the activity as above normal levels.

entries.headline: RSAF airstrike in Taiz report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an OSINTWarfare report that a Royal Saudi Air Force airstrike targeted Najd Al-Nashamah in Yemen’s Taiz Governorate. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Jerusalem Post Iran-strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Jerusalem Post report claiming Donald Trump was very close to renewing strikes on Iran as Israeli and Lebanese delegations met in Florida. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Boeing E-4B CLUB22 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing E-4B CLUB22, registration 75-0125 and hex code ADFEB6. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to Nicolas Shu via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Finland landmine-production report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a TWZ report that Finland planned to build one million landmines amid concern about Russia. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: RC-135V Rivet Joint SNOOP41 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing RC-135V Rivet Joint SNOOP41, registration 64-14841 and hex code AE01C9. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to Hongyu Wang via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: HAARP radar-testing report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a TWZ report that Alaska’s HAARP site was being used to test new U.S. Air Force over-the-horizon radar technology. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: USAF C-32A SAM47 sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported Boeing C-32A SAM47 of the U.S. Air Force 89th Airlift Wing, registration 09-0016 and hex code AE4AE8. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to Photorikoo via Planespotters.net.

entries.headline: Iraq–Iran Sheeb border-crossing closure reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported that Iraq’s prime minister ordered the Sheeb border crossing with Iran closed to people and merchandise from Wednesday. The item was credited to reagan0965.

entries.headline: Large blast in Khomeini Shahr reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported a large blast in Khomeini Shahr, Isfahan Province, Iran. The item was credited to weslester6474; no cause was stated.

entries.headline: USAF command, bomber and support aircraft airborne
entries.summary: War Watch reported a U.S. Air Force nuclear-command aircraft, two bombers, three cargo aircraft and one surveillance aircraft airborne over the continental United States.

entries.headline: UK Iran-intelligence arrest report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Associated Press report that British police had rearrested two men on suspicion of assisting Iran’s intelligence service, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: Las Vegas valley traffic peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of the previous day’s peak traffic across four Las Vegas-area airfields.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one traffic view shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass presented a day-one NBAA-BACE live view covering four Las Vegas-area airfields, with valley-wide views and closer views of KLAS and KHND.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE traffic after-action report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Las Vegas valley traffic on 19 October was down 4% while business-jet activity held steady. The post credited the data to the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.

entries.headline: Falcon 50 overrun and Las Vegas runway closures reported
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Falcon 50 N200SG rejected takeoff on runway 01L at Harry Reid International Airport, overran and struck the perimeter fence, with no injuries. It said runways 01L and 01R later reopened after inspection.

entries.headline: B737 airborne alert at Virginia Beach
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a B737 aircraft at Virginia Beach, Virginia, United States. The callsign was shown as CNV4989.

entries.headline: E-6 airborne alert at Suisun
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for an E-6 aircraft at Suisun, California, United States. The callsign was shown as NA.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Ballina
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Ballina, Ireland. The callsign was shown as PK191.

entries.headline: Tu-160M modernization report highlighted
entries.summary: SkyGlass highlighted a Defence Blog report that Russia revamped the Tu-160M Blackjack bomber with modular electronics.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Reykjanesbaer
entries.summary: SkyGlass posted an OFF Ground alert for a P-8 aircraft at Reykjanesbaer, Iceland. The callsign was shown as NA.
